name: WMO Climatological Standard Normals 1991-2020
publisher: World Meteorological Organization, archived by NOAA NCEI

measures.definition: WMO sunshine duration: hours a year with direct sunlight of at least 120 W/m², roughly the hours bright enough to cast a sharp shadow, measured at the nearest station.
WMO sunshine duration by month, measured at the nearest station.

coverage.geography: 1,842 stations in 86 countries (no USA, Canada, Portugal, Poland, Hungary, Greece, Norway or Denmark rows)

licence: No licence attached; NCEI public access, citation requested (WMO Unified Data Policy)

rights.edition: NCEI accession 0253808, version 6.6 (composite primary parameters, TSUN)
rights.attribution: WMO Member Nations (2023). WMO Climatological Standard Normals for 1991-2020 (NCEI Accession 0253808), sunshine duration. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. https://doi.org/10.25921/800j-vn07

vetted.notes: Measured sunshine by the WMO definition; chosen over ERA5 after comparing both on 27 Oct 2026.

caveats: A station within 50 km and 500 m of height, else Meteostat's nearest within 80 km, else no figure; the note names the station, its distance and height.
The composite file holds what each country submitted; a country missing here may have submitted after this version (6.6).
